home.findWorkoutDesc: 5 questions to find the perfect session
home.strengthForRunnersDesc: Science-based strength sessions to improve running economy and prevent injuries.
home.routesTitle: Build your route in one click
home.routesDesc: Real-world loop or out-and-back from your position, with elevation and GPX export.
home.cyclingDesc: 10 sessions: endurance, sweet spot, threshold, intervals. Built-in FTP zones.
home.swimmingDesc: 10 sessions: technique, endurance, sprints, pyramids. Built-in CSS zones.

today.title: What to run today
today.lead: Tell it how much time you have, Zoned hands you a session. Not three: one.
today.empty: No session matches this duration right now.

prepare.title: Prepare for a race
prepare.lead: Four settings, a readable plan before you commit. Then it's yours.

manifesto.title: A catalogue of sessions, not another logbook
manifesto.bodyBefore: Other running apps record what you did. Zoned answers the question that comes before that:
manifesto.bodyAfter: . A catalogue of documented sessions, plans you can read before committing, calculations whose formula is written out. Nothing to create, nothing nagging you back.

library.title: Every session says why it exists
library.body: Structure, paces, what it develops, when to place it in the week, and what not to stack right after it. Filterable by duration, intensity, terrain, gear.

plans.title: Generated once, adjustable after
plans.body: The twelve weeks are visible at a glance: volume, intensities, easing off, taper. Then the plan is yours — move it, swap it, delete it, shift a date: it recalculates without holding it against you.
plans.line1: Zoned generates and recommends. That's it.
plans.line2: Tracking is yours: nothing gets checked off, nothing gets logged, no session is ever "missed".

calculators.title: One input, one result, the formula
calculators.body: A recent race time gives you your VMA, and the six pace ranges apply instantly across the {{sessions}} sessions. No "calculate" button: the result follows the input.

method.title: Every number has a source
method.body: Where the six zones come from, why most of the volume is run easy, what an estimate is really worth. The formulas are written out in the open, so is the glossary, and the code is open too.
method.line1: "Estimate" is written when it is one

account.title: No account
account.body: Nothing to create, nothing to confirm. You open it, you use it.

notification.title: No notifications
notification.body: No streak to keep, no reminder, no badge. You come back when you run.

server.title: No server
server.body: Everything stays in this browser and works offline. The file you export is your backup.

subscription.title: No subscription
subscription.body: Free, no ads, open code. There's nothing to sell behind it.

footer.tagline: A scientific training journal, local, free and open. For those who want to understand what they're doing.
